definitions.explanation: A machine used for stitching fabric together, typically using a needle and thread.

examples.japanese: ミシンで{服|ふく}を{縫|ぬ}う。
examples.english: To sew clothes with a sewing machine.

examples.japanese: {母|はは}はミシンを{使|つか}ってカーテンを{作|つく}った。
examples.english: My mother made curtains using a sewing machine.

examples.japanese: このミシンは{糸|いと}が{絡|から}まりやすい。
examples.english: This sewing machine tends to get the thread tangled.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY: From English 'machine', via 'sewing machine'. The Japanese word ミシン is a shortened and altered form of the English word 'machine'.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・ミシンで{縫|ぬ}う (to sew with a sewing machine)
・ミシンをかける (to use/operate a sewing machine)
・ミシン{目|め} (machine stitching)
・ミシン{糸|いと} (sewing machine thread)

TYPES:
・{家庭用|かていよう}ミシン - home sewing machine
・{工業用|こうぎょうよう}ミシン - industrial sewing machine
・{電動|でんどう}ミシン - electric sewing machine
・{足踏|あしぶ}みミシン - treadle sewing machine

RELATED TERMS:
・{裁縫|さいほう} - sewing, needlework
・{縫|ぬ}う - to sew
・{針|はり} - needle
・{糸|いと} - thread
